name: harnessix-golden
purpose: Fixed task set for formal evaluations of releases that are expected to change the resolve rate or the task time noticeably. Not run for every release. Rules and conditions: docs/operations/golden-eval-set.md.

excluded.reason: The gold patch is graded unresolved by the official grader in this environment.
A FAIL_TO_PASS test needs IPv6; the offline task network has none, so no system can pass it.
The tests need httpbin.org; tasks run offline, so the gold patch fails too.
The tests need httpbin.org; tasks run offline, so the gold patch fails too.

conditions.model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, INT8 weights (W8A8: weights per channel, activations per token, dynamic)
conditions.serving: vLLM 0.29.0, 2 replicas on 8 Hygon DCU K100_AI (tensor parallel 4 each), max model length 262144, prefix caching, MTP speculative decoding with 1 token, at most 32 requests per replica
conditions.sampling: not set in requests; model defaults temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20
conditions.concurrency: 4 trials at a time, each trial pinned to one replica
conditions.environment: commands run inside the task container, network cut off during the agent phase; Harnessix unattended with automatic approval, mini-swe-agent in yolo mode
conditions.reference_system: mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 with its built-in SWE-bench configuration, only the budgets above changed and thinking off

grading.primary: SWE-bench official grader (swebench 5.0.2) on the exported whole-repository patch; ambiguous failures count as unresolved
grading.time: wall time per trial from agent start to agent end, including model inference and commands
grading.invalid_slots: slots that end with an infrastructure error are excluded from both numerator and denominator and reported
grading.comparison: paired by task: bootstrap over tasks (10,000 resamples, 95% interval), sign test over tasks; report resolve rate and time together
